description: The Karnataka School Education Department has introduced Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a vocational subject for Class 9 and Class 10 students under the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF).
body_lead: AI Education in Schools: Karnataka Introduces Artificial Intelligence Course Under NSQF Framework The new skill-based course will be introduced in selected government high schools from the academic year 2026-27, replacing the third-language option under the existing vocational education framework. The initiative aims to provide students with early exposure to emerging technologies and equip them with industry-oriented skills such as problem-solving, critical thinking, digital knowledge and employability skills.
